options.opa: DNA polymerase I is responsible for the synthesis of the first strand of the new DNA.
options.opb: The first strand is synthesized in the 5 '-> 3' direction and the second in the 3 '-> 5' direction.
options.opc: For the correction of the incorporated errors, the polymerase acts in the 3 '-> 5' direction.
options.opd: The Okazaki fragments are primers in the synthesis of the delayed strand.
